helpPage.title: Usizo Lokusekela
helpPage.centerDesc: Sebenzisa lesi sikhungo sosekelo ukuze weqele esicini esifanele se-Humaeli, uxazulule izinkinga ezivamile, futhi uqonde ukuthi ungaxhumana nini nosizo oluphuthumayo ngaphandle kohlelo lokusebenza.
helpPage.aiWellnessDesc: Buza imibuzo ephathelene nokuphila kahle kwengqondo, sebenzisa okokufaka kwezwi, thola izimpendulo ezisheshayo, futhi uqhubeke nengxoxo yakho yakamuva ye-AI ukusuka kudeshibhodi.
helpPage.counselorDesc: Phequlula abeluleki ngegama, ubuchwepheshe, ulimi, indawo, ukulinganisa, nesimo se-inthanethi ngaphambi kokuqala ukunakekelwa.
helpPage.appointmentsDesc: Buyekeza ama-aphoyintimenti azayo nadlule, hlola isimo sesicelo, namaseshini wokubhuka nabeluleki abatholakalayo.
helpPage.walletDesc: Engeza imali, buyekeza okwenziwayo, landa imibiko ye-wallet, futhi uxhumane nosekelo lwemibuzo yokukhokha.
helpPage.checklist1: Qinisekisa ukuxhumeka kwakho kwe-inthanethi futhi uvuselele uhlelo lokusebenza ngaphambi kokubika inkinga yokulayisha.
helpPage.checklist2: Gcina isithombe-skrini sakamuva, isikhathi esiqondile, kanye negama lesikrini lilungile uma uxhumana nosekelo.
helpPage.checklist3: Ngezinkinga zekhamera, umbhobho, isaziso, nendawo, hlola izimvume zohlelo lokusebenza lwedivayisi kuqala.
helpPage.checklist4: Ezindabeni zokukhokha, faka idethi, inani, isimo sokwenziwe, nebhalansi yesikhwama semali eboniswe ohlelweni lokusebenza.
helpPage.aiChatNotReplyDesc: Hlola ukuxhumeka kwakho kwe-inthanethi, zama ukuthumela umlayezo omfushane, bese uvule kabusha ingxoxo ye-AI ukusuka kudeshibhodi. Uma isahluleka, yabelana ngesithombe-skrini sephutha kanye nosekelo.
helpPage.counselorChatNotOpenDesc: Vula Ukusekela Umeluleki, khetha umeluleki otholakalayo, bese ulinda ukuthi isicelo samukelwe. Izingxoxo ezikhona zivela esikrinini sokuxoxa someluleki.
helpPage.callNotConnectingDesc: Qiniseka ukuthi umeluleki wamukele ingxoxo/isikhathi sakho, bobabili abasebenzisi baku-inthanethi, futhi izimvume zemakrofoni/ikhamera zivunyelwe.
helpPage.walletPaymentIssueDesc: Vula i-Wallet ukuze ubuyekeze okwenziwayo kwakamuva futhi ulande umbiko. Yabelana ngedethi, inani, nesimo sokwenziwe lapho uxhumana nosekelo.
helpPage.languageWrongDesc: Sebenzisa isikhethi solimi kudeshibhodi/izilungiselelo. Omunye umeluleki noma imininingwane yezokwelapha ingase ihlale olimini olufakwe umhlinzeki.
helpPage.needMoreHelpDesc: Buyekeza imininingwane ye-akhawunti ukusuka kokuthi Iphrofayela/Izilungiselelo, noma ukwesekwa kwe-imeyili ngezithombe-skrini, inguqulo yohlelo lokusebenza, i-imeyili/ifoni yomsebenzisi, kanye nesikhathi esiqondile inkinga eyenzeka ngaso. Ngosekelo lwezinhlekelele e-India, shayela ku-9152987821 noma izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zendawo.

privacyPage.title: Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo
privacyPage.centerDesc: Lesi sikhungo sobumfihlo sichaza ukuthi i-Humaeli isebenzisa kanjani iphrofayela yakho, ingxoxo, i-aphoyintimenti, isikhwama semali, ikholi, indawo, nedatha yezokuphepha ngaphakathi kwalolu hlelo lokusebenza lweselula.
privacyPage.profileHealthDesc: Igama lakho, igama elingaziwa eliboniswayo, ubudala, ubulili, imininingwane yokuxhumana, isithombe/i-avatar, ikheli, othintana naye izimo eziphuthumayo, imininingwane yezokwelapha eyisisekelo, nezinkundla zomshwalense zisetshenziselwa ukugcina iphrofayela yakho yesiguli.
privacyPage.aiConversationsDesc: Imilayezo, izimpendulo ezisheshayo, isimo sengxoxo, okunamathiselwe kwi-imeyili, izikhathi zengxoxo ezamukelwe, nemininingwane yomeluleki isetshenziselwa ukunikeza izingxoxo, ukuqhubeka nomlando, kanye nokusekelwa kokwaziswa kwesilinganiso.
privacyPage.appointmentsDesc: Idethi ye-aphoyintimenti, isikhathi, isizathu/amanothi, isimo, umeluleki owabelwe, imethadatha yekholi, nomlando weseshini usiza abasebenzisi nabeluleki ukuphatha ukunakekelwa.
privacyPage.walletDesc: Ibhalansi ye-wallet, izengezo, amarekhodi okwenziwayo, imibiko ekhiqiziwe, nomongo wosekelo ohlobene usetshenziselwa ukulandelela inkokhelo.
privacyPage.locationDesc: Indawo ingathwetshulwa ekubhaliseni, ekungeneni ngemvume, noma ekuvuselelweni mathupha ukuze kuqinisekiswe izikhathi, kusekelwe ukuphepha kwe-akhawunti, futhi kuthuthukiswe izici zokunakekela eziqaphela indawo.
privacyPage.securityDesc: Amathokheni okungena ngemvume, umhlinzeki we-auth, isimo sephasiwedi, ukuqinisekiswa kwe-OTP, indima, nesimo se-akhawunti kusetshenziselwa ukugcina izindawo zabasebenzisi kanye nabeluleki zihlukanisiwe futhi zivikelekile.
privacyPage.visibleDesc: Ideshibhodi yakho ibonisa iphrofayela yakho, izingxoxo ze-AI, ukusebenzelana komeluleki, ama-aphoyintimenti, isikhwama semali, umlando wekholi, ukwaziswa kwezilinganiso, nezilawuli zendawo/zesibuyekezo.
privacyPage.sharedDesc: Abeluleki bangabona ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze baphathe izikhathi ezamukelwe, ama-aphoyintimenti, nezingxoxo zosekelo. Ubunikazi obungaziwa busetshenziswa lapho kusekelwa khona.
privacyPage.protectedDesc: Izindawo zabasebenzisi nabeluleki zihlukaniswa ngendima, izikhathi ezisebenzayo, ukuqinisekiswa kwe-OTP, nezicelo eziqinisekisiwe ze-API.
privacyPage.checklistItem1: Sebenzisa igama lakho elingaziwa ekusebenzelaneni nomeluleki uma ungafuni ukuthi igama lakho langempela liboniswe.
privacyPage.checklistItem2: Gcina othintana nabo abezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nemininingwane yephrofayela yezokwelapha inembile uma ukhetha ukuyigcwalisa.
privacyPage.checklistItem3: Buyekeza izimvume zedivayisi zendawo, ikhamera, nemakrofoni ngaphambi kwezingcingo.
privacyPage.checklistItem4: Buyekeza indawo mathupha kokuthi Izilungiselelo/Iphrofayela uma umyalo wokungena weqiwe.
privacyPage.checklistItem5: Ungabelani ngama-OTP, amaphasiwedi, noma imininingwane ye-akhawunti ebucayi ngaphakathi kwemilayezo yengxoxo.
privacyPage.checklistItem6: Sebenzisa Iphrofayela Yami kanye Nezilungiselelo ukuze ubuyekeze noma ubuyekeze idatha egcinwe ku-akhawunti yakho.
